name: Process: Run a lead's check-in, review, career conversation, and range breach count on the team's reading once the holder is ruled
text_content:
P6, P7, P8, P10, P13, with I1 and rows 184 to 187. The monthly lead-and-partner conversation runs as a check-in placed by the stack at a closed hour on the clock, on the lead's own page, on the check-in's spine with its refusals, with the lead's line in the lead's words and the partner's questions, held by one partner per lead and no partner holding both; the review runs on the same form against the lead's sheet with the upward half aggregated by mechanism and never by person and no calibration between the two leads' reviews; the career conversation runs once on the lead's sheet with outward tracks; every range breach on a lead's entry is counted per period by kind on the leads' review record by the chair, read first at its mechanism, then once as a hypothesis at the lead's check-in; the chair alternates by week with a chair held two weeks running as a record fault; and the founders hold the first leads' check-ins on the same form by default until ruled. Extends 86akhb2jg, 86akh6742, 86akh675n, 17tn048qepw, and 17tn048qck6 by reference. High.

Filed by Session 15 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmjpw. Reasoning lives on the S15 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
